name: @huddle/controller
description: Huddle Controller app: the phone client every player joins a room with.
//scripts: The Controller runs its Metro on 8082; the TV keeps the default 8081. A game needs both apps up at once, and a debug build asks whichever port it was built against for its bundle — so left on the same port the phone silently loads the *television's* bundle and draws a shrunken pairing screen. Nothing errors, which is what makes it expensive to spot. RCT_METRO_PORT is the one the native build bakes in, so it has to be set on `ios` as well, and the two must agree. LC_ALL is CocoaPods 1.17 on Ruby 4, which crashes in `Pod::Config#installation_root` without a UTF-8 locale. REACT_NATIVE_NODE_MODULES_DIR is react-native-svg's documented escape hatch, and this app needs it for exactly the reason the TV does: its podspec resolves `react-native/package.json`, lands in `react-native-tvos/` because of the alias below, looks for a sibling `react-native/` that pnpm never created, and dies on `File.join(nil, ...)`. It arrived here with the icon set — `expo export` never runs CocoaPods, so nothing but a native build catches its absence. The TV's note is the longer version of the same story; the two apps now set the same three variables.
